about.description: Single-stock perpetual futures market on QFEX tracking Churchill Capital Corp XI, quoted in USD, cross-margined in USDC and trading 24/7 with up to 10x leverage. QFEX is a hybrid central-limit-order-book exchange for traditional assets only; positions are cash-settled and confer no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Reference prices are consumed from primary venues during the instrument's published reference-price hours and funding is zero outside them. Ticker caution: CCXI was ChemoCentryx, Inc. until Amgen acquired it in October 2022; it now belongs to Churchill Capital Corp XI, a Cayman Islands blank-cheque company incorporated 2025-06-04. A merger agreement with Agility Robotics, Inc. was signed 2026-06-24 and the combined company is expected to trade as AGLT, so this Reference Asset is expected to change.
